720: HelloSquad brings together seven AI agents specialized in different areas of marketing.
721: They know the context of your business, collaborate with each other and help turn your needs into work and deliverables.
722: Do I need to understand marketing to use it?
723: No. You can explain what you need in your own words.
724: The Squad helps organize your ideas, identify the specialists needed and develop the work with you.
725: Can I talk directly to each agent?
726: Yes. You can talk to Nexo, talk directly to a specialist or use the Squad Room.
727: When a job requires different skills, the agents can collaborate with each other.
728: What can the agents do for my business?
729: The Squad was designed to help with strategy, visual identity, content, campaigns, customer relationships and results analysis.
730: The available deliverables depend on the features and the plan you choose.
732: You can delegate recurring responsibilities, such as preparing content every week or tracking results.
733: The Squad organizes the next cycles within the agreed scope. You follow the progress and take part in the decisions needed.
734: Can the Squad publish or invest without my approval?
735: Connecting an account or asking for work does not mean authorizing any action.
736: Posts, sends and investments depend on the corresponding permissions and approvals. You keep control over the limits of the operation.
737: How do the agents get to know my brand?
738: Squad Memory gathers information about your business, identity, goals, preferences and previous decisions.
739: This knowledge can be shared among the specialists and added to or corrected over time.
740: Do I need to connect my social media to start?
741: No. You can start by sharing the information you already have. Website, files and channels can help the Squad understand your business better.
742: The available connections can be set up according to the integrations the platform offers.

744: Creating an account is free. Some deliverables may use credits, depending on the plan and the type of work.
